tooltip.2048_core.1: Click the center of the core block front face to start.

tooltip.2048_core.3: Matching numbers merge and give score.
tooltip.2048_core.4: The game ends when no moves remain.
tooltip.memory_key_core.1: Click the top of the core block to unfold, then click again to start.

tooltip.minesweeper_core.1: Click the center of the core block top face to unfold or start.

tooltip.minesweeper_core.4: Click a cell to reveal it.
